name: graphql-infrastructure

states.name: GraphiQL Interactive IDE
states.description: The GraphiQL IDE loads at GET /graphql. Provides a query editor, results panel, and schema documentation explorer.

states.name: API Endpoint
states.description: POST /graphql accepts GraphQL queries and returns JSON results. The ping mutation is the simplest smoke test.

states.name: Dual Transport Architecture
states.description: Queries and mutations use HTTP POST to /graphql. Subscriptions use WebSocket at /graphql/ws via the graphql-ws protocol. The Apollo Client split link routes operations automatically based on type. The WS connection is lazy — only established when the first subscription is created. The HTTP link injects X-Trace-Id headers for distributed tracing. An ErrorLink intercepts errors and logs them with operation name, detecting circuit breaker and concurrency limit conditions.

states.name: Schema Type Contract
states.description: The GraphQL schema (722 lines SDL) defines the typed API contract. Domain entity types: GqlTaskRun (35 fields), GqlWorkflowSummary, GqlWorkflow, GqlFinding (with GqlFindingCategory, GqlFindingSeverity, GqlFindingStatus, GqlFindingActionType enums), GqlFindingSummary, GqlRunnerStatus, GqlOrchestrationLoopStatus, GqlTaskRunOutput. Input types: CreateTaskRunInput, UpdateFindingStatusInput. UI Bridge types: UiBridgeHealth, ActionResult, SdkConnectionInfo, UiBridgeErrorDetail with UiBridgeErrorCode (13 variants). Union type: RunnerEvent with 7 variants (OrchestratorStateChange, StepProgress, TaskRunUpdate, FindingDetected, FindingResolved, AiOutputChunk, GenericEvent).

states.name: Resolver Inventory
states.description: 30 query resolvers: 18 UI Bridge (elements, snapshot, components, windows, consoleErrors, networkRequests, forms, idleStatus, keyboardShortcuts, renderLog, undoState, specs, diagnostics, health, rawQuery) + 12 domain (taskRuns, taskRun, taskRunOutput, runningTaskRuns, childTaskRuns, workflows, workflow, findings, findingSummary, runnerStatus, orchestrationLoopStatus, sdkConnections). 23 mutation resolvers: 14 UI Bridge (executeAction, pageNavigate, pageRefresh, pageBack, pageForward, fillForm, querySelector, evaluate, undo, redo, clearConsoleErrors, resetCircuitBreaker, rawCommand, ping) + 9 domain (createTaskRun, stopTaskRun, pauseTaskRun, unpauseTaskRun, deleteTaskRun, updateFindingStatus, respondToFinding, runWorkflow, deleteWorkflow). 5 subscription resolvers: uiBridgeHealthStream, runnerEvents, taskRunProgress, findingUpdates, orchestrationLoopStatusStream.

states.name: Subscription Lifecycle
states.description: Subscriptions have managed lifecycles: findingUpdates polls DB every 2s with hash-based dedup (emits only on change), auto-closes after 30min TTL or 2 ticks after task reaches terminal status. orchestrationLoopStatusStream pushes every 2s, auto-closes after 2h TTL or when loop reaches Complete/Stopped/Error phase. uiBridgeHealthStream pushes at configurable interval (default 3s). runnerEvents and taskRunProgress filter the broadcast channel — runnerEvents accepts an optional type filter array, taskRunProgress filters to a specific task_run_id. All subscriptions skip activation when their skip parameter is true (e.g., no task ID, task is terminal).

states.name: Security and Rate Limiting
states.description: Query depth limit: 12. Complexity limit: 500. Concurrent HTTP request limit: 20 (WebSocket subscriptions excluded). Introspection disabled in release builds (#[cfg(not(dev))]). CORS is permissive (localhost-only API). Error classification maps error strings to 13 typed UiBridgeErrorCode variants for machine-readable error handling.

states.name: Frontend Hooks Library
states.description: 27 typed hooks in src/hooks/graphql/: 11 query hooks (useTaskRunsGql, useTaskRunGql, useTaskRunOutputGql, useRunningTaskRunsGql, useTaskRunsLazyGql, useWorkflowsGql, useWorkflowGql, useFindingsGql, useFindingSummaryGql, useRunnerStatusGql, useOrchestrationLoopStatusGql, useUiBridgeHealthGql), 9 mutation hooks (useStopTaskRunGql, usePauseTaskRunGql, useUnpauseTaskRunGql, useDeleteTaskRunGql, useCreateTaskRunGql, useRunWorkflowGql, useUpdateFindingStatusGql, useRespondToFindingGql, useDeleteWorkflowGql), 5 subscription hooks (useHealthStream, useRunnerEvents, useTaskRunProgress, useFindingUpdates, useOrchestrationLoopStream), 2 composite hooks (useTaskRunControls: stop/pause/unpause/remove with error handling; useTaskRunLive: combines query + 2 subscriptions + paginated output into a single real-time view with 500-event ring buffer).

states.name: Type Generation Pipeline
states.description: Schema SDL is auto-exported by Rust test (schema_exports_valid_sdl) to src-tauri/src/graphql/schema.graphql (722 lines). GraphQL Code Generator reads the SDL + src/hooks/graphql/documents.ts and outputs src/generated/graphql.ts (855 lines) with all type definitions. Scripts: 'npm run graphql:schema' exports SDL, 'npm run graphql:codegen' generates TypeScript, 'npm run graphql:check' validates codegen output is up-to-date via git diff. Codegen uses typescript + typescript-operations plugins with enumsAsConst and JSON scalar mapped to unknown.

description: GraphQL Infrastructure — the full-stack GraphQL system including backend schema, frontend Apollo Client, typed hooks library, codegen pipeline, and GraphiQL playground. The schema has 30 queries, 23 mutations, and 5 subscriptions served via async-graphql v7 on Axum. The frontend uses Apollo Client v4 with HTTP+WS split link. TypeScript types are auto-generated from the SDL via graphql-codegen.
